photoAdvice: Take the photo straight-on with the whole palm facing the camera and all fingers spread.
Flatten the palm (don't cup it), spread the fingers, and use soft, even light with no harsh shadow across the palm.
If creases are still faint, send a second shot from a slightly different angle / tilt so the lines catch the light.
